overall_goal: Prepare utensils, weigh ingredients, and adjust batter consistency for making dosas

goals.description: Prepare workspace and gather initial utensils
goals.rationale: The person adjusts the pan, moves a cup and batter bowl, and retrieves a tablespoon from the cutlery drawer.

goals.description: Close the olive oil bottle and get metallic cups
goals.rationale: The person closes the olive oil bottle and retrieves a stack of metallic cups from a drawer.
The person turns on the scale, writes down the ingredient name, weighs the ghee, and logs the weight in a notebook.

goals.description: Retrieve a new ladle from the cabinet and reorganize fallen items
goals.rationale: The person pulls out a new ladle from the cabinet, dropping some items, and then picks up and reorganizes the fallen items.

goals.description: Unpack, wash, and dry the new ladle
goals.rationale: The person discards the ladle's packaging, washes the new ladle under the tap, and dries it with a kitchen rag.

goals.description: Check the consistency of the dosa batter
goals.rationale: The person uses a whisk to check the consistency of the dosa batter and taps off the excess.

goals.description: Retrieve a measuring cup from the drawers
goals.rationale: The person opens several cabinets and drawers to find and pull out a plastic measuring cup.

goals.description: Adjust the dosa batter consistency by adding water
goals.rationale: The person scoops batter to check its thickness, adds water from a small cup, scrapes the whisk, and stirs the batter to reach the right consistency.

goals.description: Move the heated ghee cup and organize the chopping board
goals.rationale: The person checks the temperature of the ghee cup on the pan and moves it to the chopping board alongside other items.

goals.description: Search for a suitable spatula in the drawers
goals.rationale: The person searches through drawers, examining and testing different spatulas to find one suitable for lifting dosas.
